title: Introduction and overview — B-24 Liberator
description: Introduction and overview of the B-24 Liberator: What this aircraft is, its role, and why it matters in aviation history. The B-24 Liberator is a four-engine heavy bomber built by Consolidated, the most-produced American military aircraft in history with 18,482 built. Its long range made it the key bomber in the Pacific and in closing the Atlantic Gap against U-boats. It flew from factories including Ford's Willow Run plant. Baseline facts: Four-engine WWII heavy bomber; 18,482 built by Consolidated; most-produced U.S. military aircraft..
